author: IGN
description:
To survive the treacherous waters of Windrose, a basic raft simply won't cut it. From fending off Blackbeard’s pirates to navigating the brutal archipelago, your ship is your lifeline. In this guide, we break down everything you need to get your vessel sea-ready, including how to unlock the Shipwright’s Workshop, the best way to farm Copper for hull bracing, and how to track down the legendary 36-pounder cannons. Whether you’re just starting the “I Need A Bigger Boat” quest or you’re ready to command the high seas, these tips will ensure your crew stays afloat.

We dive deep into the progression systems of Windrose, detailing how to earn reputation with factions like the Rogue Buccaneers and the Smugglers of Port Royal. Learn the most efficient ways to farm Piastre by looting ruins and selling artifacts, and find out exactly what requirements you need to meet to unlock the Epic Frigate—the best ship in the game. We also cover essential mechanics like using the Wharf for customization,
title: 10 Essential Ship Tips for Windrose: Upgrades, Rare Gear, and More

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The face model for the PlayStation Spider-Man games may have leaked that the next Spider-Man game is well into production. In a post since deleted from his Instagram, actor Ben Jordan can be seen in a mocap suit with the caption, "IYKYK" with a spider emoji. Insomniac has not officially announced any new Spider-Man game, but a leak from 2024 suggests the next entry is in the works. In other news, Sony announced at this year's Cinemacon that a Bloodborne animated movie is in the works, and YouTuber JackSepticeye will be producing. And finally, Sony also revealed that the Zelda movie being produced with Nintendo has wrapped filming in New Zealand. The movie has a 2027 release date.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Spider-Man 3 Game Accidentally Teased by Face Model - IGN Daily Fix

The supernatural thriller follows Jo Beckett, a devoted schoolteacher whose life is upended when her young son mysteriously vanishes. As his eerie behavior spreads paranoia and violence through their rural town, Jo’s desperate search leads her through a maze of folklore, paranoia, and faith.

author: IGN
description:
The Further comes for our world.
Watch the official trailer for #Insidious: Out Of The Further - exclusively in cinemas this August.

Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.

In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.

With Lin Shaye reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier and Jacob Chase (Come Play) directing, Insidious: Out of the Further opens August 20, 2026. Screenplay by Jacob Chase. Story by David Lesl
title: Insidious: Out of the Further - Official Trailer (2026) Amelia Eve, Brandon Perea
